trailhead.label: Bergerplatz, the central square of St. Magdalena (official start)

waypoints.label: Drinking-water tap at the Naturparkhaus, 116 m off the route

cautions: This package has not yet had a dated field review; check signs on the ground.
About 2 km on asphalt farm roads, hot in summer.
Shared access roads without pavement (residents’ traffic, 30 km/h).
Short dirt steps on the meadow path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Local lead rules and temporary closures can change.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
